supervised_segmentation.alignment: Each H5 index is 0..1800; all source map spans are 1800 frames. Numeric inputs select 0..1799, matching pinned ResiFuse truncation to official label length. No source video was downloaded, so visual pose-to-video alignment was not independently tested.
supervised_segmentation.frozen_model_output_contract: predict_proba returns independent float probabilities [1800,4] in fixed class order for each full clip; the owner serializes Test predictions and no label-selected inference window is used.
supervised_segmentation.metric_boundary: Only any-positive grouped-behavior frames with source-style pose validity are scored. Background-only false alarms are not measured; this is a Bench adaptation, not a ResiFuse paper score.

representation_classification.subsets: Three fixed 80% sequence samples, floor(4*N/5), lowest SHA256 ranks from seeds 0, 1, 2. This policy is public and Bench-specific because exact paper memberships and sampling unit are unpublished.
representation_classification.frozen_model_output_contract: embed returns finite float embedding [1800,d], 1<=d<=128, common d; the owner serializes all 1830 submission embeddings and fits fixed balanced Ridge probes. The Agent sees no six-target label files or submission poses during development.
representation_classification.metric_boundary: Per-sequence positive F1 gives zero to an all-negative sequence, including a correctly predicted negative condition sequence. It is a disclosed Bench convention, not an original evaluator equivalence claim.

safe_extraction: Object NPY files were unpickled only inside a disposable Docker container (local image sha256:81e3aad255285fddf094d885b3fb4facc9efcafe6c2c05bfcab298ae805eb562) with no network, read-only container filesystem, dropped capabilities, no-new-privileges, and only the data directory mounted. Host-side consumers load only numeric NPZ with allow_pickle=False. H5 column metadata uses a restricted unpickler that rejects class imports.
remaining_gates: Source license/provenance and redistribution review before mirroring or publishing data
Isolated Agent packet and inference acceptance, including strict mount whitelist and owner-only Test scorer
Optional source video route requires separate download and visual frame alignment; pose-only supervised route is prepared
